$comment: Blind rater O. Seed 149, fresh lineage, production build at :5230 via the GPU harness (400x800@3). Notes and screenshots in scratchpad/raterO/. Read only RATING.md, FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK.md 1-3 and the template; did not open PLAN.md, research/, CUT*.md, PLATEAU.md, INTEGRATION.md, other cards or source. Audio unassessed (harness has a sink but I cannot listen; window.__audio logged 1045 cues of rule/hit/slay, with 13 cues stamped on one identical timestamp during a fast-forward stretch, so I cannot vouch for timing). The absence was simulated with ?absent=8h, so `return` is scored the same sitting, against the protocol's anti-bias advice; I wrote down before loading it that I wanted to come back (to see whether bank-at-D8 accumulates gold overnight and whether auto-restock drains it).

absences: 8h simulated (?absent=8h), taken once after 32 min cold; 12 min on return

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: I sent the curious fighter down with a rule to read unknown scrolls when hurt, and he shrugged off gas and poison on D6, then stood in a one-wide corridor trading arrows with an archer for eight turns while a goblin chewed his back. He walked down to D8 at 10 of 36 hp because nothing I wrote said not to, met the goblin warlord with $325 in his pack, and the screen said '1 hp short'. That was the run that taught me to write a bank rule, and the next hero came home with $198.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: probe: I edited a rule inside minute two and never wondered what to do; twice I did not know what had just happened. evidence: the watch callout reads 'R2 ATTACK JACKAL' and the camp forecast flipped 'D5 94% -> 80% · jackal 57%' within a second of moving my pack rule above attack, so every action showed its consequence. lapse: 'drink ✗ no use' fired every few seconds on run 1 and I could not tell why my R3 was failing until the death replay; the supplies '×' clears the whole list (I lost the leash by accident); '◯ spectral hound fell', 'rallied!' and a '1 combo' label were never explained.

probe: bank at D8 or D10 — I chose 10 after banking $198, lost $153, went back to 8, then 10 again on return with a L4 fighter; I would make it again because the forecast showed 'D8 85% ±8' one way and 'D9 57% ±16' the other. evidence: with seven rows full every patch came in as '7/6 · drop one', so each death forced a real trade (I dropped 'adjacent ≥ 2 → attack lowest' because the trace said 'adj not ≥2' twice, and dropped the gas rule then watched 'gas 39%' become the top killer). lapse: the forecast's ±15 noise meant identical rules up to D8 read 85% one moment and 63% the next, so single-row A/B often could not be settled.

probe: an hour ago I could not keep a hero past D4; now I know heal must sit above the boss rule, that rest needs a row, and that a depth → bank rule is the run economy. evidence: death 6 read 'goblin · D8 · 1 hp short · heal unused · gap' with R1 attack boss on all five trace ticks — my ordering — and after moving drink heal to R1 the next run showed 'R1 · drink heal' taking him 11 -> 34 at D5. lapse: the thief guard card I bought (four rules for ◆3) changed nothing visible — the monkey still 'took the heal, D5' — so I still do not know how to stop the den.

probe: I sweated on run 3 when he went down the stairs at 10/36 with '$325 · death: lose all' in the corner, and the game noticed — the HUD turned '$153 · keeps $153 · bank at D8' green once I had a bank rule, and the report line 'died $0 · $325 carried · keeps 0%' is the stake I chose. evidence: six of eight deaths were '1 hp short' or '2 hp short'; the overnight stake (bank at D8, auto-restock $200 a run) resolved as '10 BANKED · 2 DEATHS'. lapse: at watch speed a whole fight resolves in five seconds, and '1 hp short' on six of eight deaths starts to read as tuned rather than earned.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: probe: what felt good was the big hero sprite squaring up between 'ARCHER' and 'GOBLIN' in a one-wide corridor with the callout 'R4 ATTACK GOBLIN' stamped above (screenshot 23_run3_095); taps landed instantly, no lag anywhere. evidence: 25–35 callouts a minute at 'fights' speed ('−2 archer', 'archer draws', 'it swells', 'pops!'). audio: unassessed. why not higher: between fights the hero jumps floors in a blur ('D1 · 14 rooms' to 'D3 · 15 rooms' in two seconds), labels overlap ('MONKMONKEY' on the den replay), and hits are a number, not a blow.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: probe: the bloat that 'swells' then 'pops!' after my retreat rule, the den monkey stealing the heal in the WATCH replay, 'ogre winds up' before a −6, and the warlord that 'rallies' six goblins each changed a row I wrote (gas rule, thief guard, boss rule). repeats: the same D3 den took the heal on three runs, the D6 archer corridor duel played out four times, and 'jackal · D4' killed heroes 1 and 2 identically; the encounter mix by D6 stopped surprising me.

probe: my fighter heals first, hits the boss, guards against thieves and gas with two cards, attacks anything, rests under half, and walks home at D8 — a greedy banker, not a diver. evidence: the camp itself counts 'yours: 3 of 7 rows · card R3 first', which is honest: two rows are the game's cards and two are its defaults, and the patch list steered me toward the same shapes (return / retreat / attack <type>) every death.

probe: see delayedRecall — run 3 has a road (gas, poison, the corridor duel), a turn (stairs at 10/36) and an end (warlord, 1 hp short, $325 gone). evidence: the chronicle line '♟3 the curious fighter · D8 · found ♟2's bones · found ♟1's bones · fell to the Warlord · left bones on D8' and the overnight reel 'A jackal cornered him to 1 HP; R1 attacked; died to gas.' both carry setup, turn and end. lapse: every reel line has the same 'X took him to N HP; Rn verbed; outcome' shape, and the overnight report reels five of twelve runs.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: in-run: at 'fights' speed a run is 25 s to 2.5 min with a callout every 2–3 s and no dead stretch over 5 s. check-in: death -> read trace -> tap patch or reorder -> 'drop one' -> send took 1–3 min and always ended on a chosen send; the return report took about two minutes to read. cadence: I only took the overnight; it produced something distinct ('12 RUNS · 10 BANKED', STALL, rank 3->5). lapse: D1–D3 fly past in two seconds so I never watched the early floors, and every patch tap lands as '7/6 · drop one' friction.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: probe: I lost run 1 because my own R3 drank the heal at 22/36 — the screen said 'R1 drink heal no item ← drunk heal at 22/36 hp' and WATCH replayed 'FREE, SO R3 DRINK ?'. evidence: all eight deaths read 'cause · depth · N hp short · verdict' with a five-tick trace (rule, hp, foes, telegraph), a per-rule status ('R3 hit weakest adj not ≥2', 'R2 hit boss not in view ← never met') and three patches with 'survives 92% · base 83%'; the next hero is one tap away. lapse: death 7 offered 'foe: boss → attack boss' as a patch when that was already my R2, and 'swapped for the poison' named an engine chore no row of mine could touch.

probe: nobody asked me to write 'depth ≥ 8 → bank', to stay fighter when the class sheet offered 'rogue L1 vanish, throw, backstab', or to drink unknowns at 'hp > 75%'; the ledger of '?' rows and the forge's 'summon ally salvaged 7/15 → tier 1' were things I found by poking. limit: inside the run the chores choose the route ('the chores explored; reached D7'), and the depth picker offers only 2/3/5/8/10/12 so 'bank at 7' was not a goal I could set.

within-run: 'VAULT · axe +1 · mail +1 · teleport scroll' picked up, XP 'fighter +119 · L2'. persistent: ◆ after nearly every death bought '+1 row', 'verb: throw · reach +78%', two cards, 'supplies 3 → 5'; the verb picker grew from 14 entries to 'attack pack … drink invisibility … read enchant … tame boss' after one deep run, and the overnight added 'strength pearly · darkness folded · speed murky'. automation: 'auto: restock' bought at minute 25 (one 'no longer need to' in 44 min). lapse: restock silently spent $200 a run ($1227 -> $827 in two sends) and the vault replaced my kept heal potion with 'axe +3' without asking.

probe: an olive-and-khaki pixel dungeon with a big red-tunic fighter, chunky pixel callouts and a black terminal camp; I would not sit in it doing nothing, but I liked looking at the corridor stand-off. audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: probe: I came back to '12 RUNS · D8 BEST · ◆+9 · 10 BANKED · 2 DEATHS', $1227 in camp against ~$300 banked in 32 active minutes, 'rested 260m', a STALL card saying 'R7 bank ended 6 runs at D8' with 'R7 ↻ depth ≥ 9 → bank · reach +25%', and a PENDING line 'R2 fired 0 of 4 runs: boss → hit boss'; because of it I raised the bank to D10, bought thief guard and gas step, and re-read the night death's trace ('den took the heal, D3' again). I would not rather have stayed. lapse: supplies came back '0/5' and the vault had swapped my heal potion for an axe, both without a line saying so.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: probe: the last run ended because the gas-step card I bought told him to 'hold' while archers drew — 'R4 card gas step' on all five ticks — after I had deleted my own 'foe: ranged → attack ranged' row to make room for the boss rule; that was my trade, and the game offered the deleted row straight back at 92%. evidence: five of eight deaths end in a row I wrote or ordered (R3 drank the heal; retreat 'no path ← foes hold the way'; 'heal unused' with boss above heal; bank at 10 instead of 8; the card), and the two banks were 'R7 bank ended … at D8', my rule. lapse: three deaths trace to 'den/monkey took the heal' and one to 'cowardly → retreat', a trait, neither of which I could own even after buying the thief card.
